name: FSDnoisy18k
description: Noisy-label sound-event classification dataset with about 42.5k audio clips and 20 classes, distinct from FSD50K. Freesound per-clip terms apply; no data is vendored.
citation: Fonseca et al. (2019). FSDnoisy18k: a dataset for sound event classification with noisy labels.

license.identifier: Freesound per-clip terms apply; licenses vary by clip and are not represented by one SPDX identifier.
